# SPREAD GLOBAL Website

Follow the brand and UX brief in `../copilot-instructions.md`. Keep the React + Vite + strict TypeScript stack, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, and Lucide React. Preserve responsive behavior, keyboard access, WCAG AA contrast, the obsidian/alabaster/gold palette, and purposeful GPU-composited animations. Keep page sections modular in `src/components/` and validate with `npm run build`.
